subject: Post-discovery: scheduling ML/Infra technical handoff for NextEngine
messages:
From: Ari Chen <ari@nextengine.ai>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Samira Patel <samira@nextengine.ai>
Date: Wed, 01 Dec 2027 15:42:00 -0800
Subject: Quick follow-up + request to schedule ML/Infra handoff

Hi Karthik —

Thanks again for the discovery call earlier today. We came away excited about Redwood's routing and KV cache ideas — a few things jumped to the top for our infra and security teams. The product folks asked whether we can schedule a 60–90 minute technical handoff so your ML/Infra engineers can walk our ops, platform, and security leads through:

- model variants and fallback policies
- autoscaling and dedicated capacity behaviors
- prefix/KV caching and expected SLO gains
- SOC2/PII controls and evidence we should expect

Can we aim for next-week windows? Timezone: PST (our team in SF). Samira (cc) will own the calendar on our side. We can do a weekday morning (10:00–12:00 PST) or late afternoon (15:00–17:00 PST). If you prefer, send a few proposed slots and a short draft agenda and we'll pick. Also please include any pre-reads you want us to review.

- Ari
Ari Chen
CTO, NextEngine
ari@nextengine.ai

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Ari Chen <ari@nextengine.ai>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Samira Patel <samira@nextengine.ai>
Date: Thu, 02 Dec 2027 09:15:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up + request to schedule ML/Infra handoff

Ari — thanks for the note and great to hear the call landed well. Happy to run a 60–90 min session with our infra and platform leads. Proposed slots (all PST):

- Tue 2027-12-07 10:30–12:00
- Wed 2027-12-08 15:00–16:30 (if you prefer late afternoon)
- Thu 2027-12-09 11:00–12:30

Draft agenda (we'll refine once attendees are confirmed):
1) 5m — introductions & success criteria
2) 25m — runtime architecture & routing/fallback behavior
3) 20m — capacity, autoscaling, and batching strategies
4) 15m — security/compliance: data paths, audit logging, SOC2 artifacts
5) 15–25m — Q&A + mutual action items (M.A.P.)

I'm attaching a short pre-read (NextEngine_pre-read.pdf) with an architecture snapshot and the mutual_action_plan.xlsx template to capture owners and deadlines. Ben will join the call for the capacity/autoscale section. If you have a security owner to add, please share their email and we'll include them.

If any of those slots work, Samira can lock the calendar and we'll send a calendar invite with a Google Meet link and the pre-reads.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

Attachment: NextEngine_pre-read.pdf (1.2 MB)
Attachment: mutual_action_plan.xlsx (45 KB)

From: Samira Patel <samira@nextengine.ai>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 03 Dec 2027 08:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up + request to schedule ML/Infra handoff

On Thu, Dec 2, 2027 at 09:15 AM karthik_iyer@redwood.com wrote:
> Ari — thanks for the note and great to hear the call landed well. Happy to run a 60–90 min session with our infra and platform leads. Proposed slots (all PST):
>
> - Tue 2027-12-07 10:30–12:00
> - Wed 2027-12-08 15:00–16:30 (if you prefer late afternoon)
> - Thu 2027-12-09 11:00–12:30

Hi Karthik / Ben —

Thanks for the options. Ari and I chatted and Tue 2027-12-07 10:30–12:00 PST works best for our full group (ops + security + product). Adding our security lead, Sam Huang (sam.huang@nextengine.ai) — can you include them on the invite?

Two quick asks before the call:
1) Can you confirm which SOC2 artifact set you typically share (bridging questions for our compliance team)?
2) If there are any short infra benchmarks (latency/throughput profiles) for the 2k–10k request/day range, a one-page summary would be helpful to share with procurement ahead of the technical review.

We'll lock the slot once you confirm and send a calendar invite.

— Samira
Samira Patel
Head of Product Operations, NextEngine
samira@nextengine.ai

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Ari Chen <ari@nextengine.ai>, Samira Patel <samira@nextengine.ai>, sam.huang@nextengine.ai
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 05 Dec 2027 09:10:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up + request to schedule ML/Infra handoff

Samira / Ari / Sam — confirmed. I've locked Tue 2027-12-07 10:30–12:00 PST on our side and sent a calendar invite (Google Meet link included). Invite includes Ben and me as Redwood attendees; Ben will lead the autoscaling/capacity discussion and I will run the runtime + caching overview.

Per your asks:
- SOC2 artifacts: we'll share the standard SOC2 Type II summary and our control matrix prior to the call (redacted where necessary). Expect a short packet by EOD Mon 2027-12-06.
- Benchmarks: attached is a 1-page latency/throughput snapshot for the 2k–10k daily request profile (benchmarks_summary.pdf). If you'd like deeper numbers we can follow up after the handoff or add a small eval run to the M.A.P.

Final attendee list (please confirm additions):
- NextEngine: Ari Chen (CTO), Samira Patel (Head of Product Ops), Sam Huang (Security)
- Redwood: Karthik Iyer (Solutions Engineer), Ben Carter (Senior Sales Engineer)

Final agenda (attached in invite): same as the draft — we've added a 10m 'success criteria' box at the top so we can capture acceptance criteria live. Please fill the mutual_action_plan.xlsx with your owners/target dates if you can before the meeting; we'll update ours in the call.

See you Tuesday — I'll post the pre-reads and HubSpot link in the invite notes.

Thanks,
Karthik

Attachment: benchmarks_summary.pdf (120 KB)
